colophon: Thus ends the Bala Krishna Raksha Kavacha made by Nanda, in the fifth chapter of the fifth part of the Vishnu Purana.

lines.2: May Hari protect you, the source of all beings,
lines.3: from whose navel sprang the lotus from which the world came to be.
lines.4: He on the tip of whose tusk the earth was held up, the earth that holds the world:
lines.5: may that god, Keshava, who took the form of the Boar, protect you.
lines.6: The mighty one who split his enemy's chest with the tips of his claws:
lines.7: may Janardana, in the form of the Man Lion, protect you everywhere.
lines.8: May Vamana always protect you, who in a single moment became
lines.9: Trivikrama, whose strides overran the three worlds, his weapons flashing.
lines.10: May Govinda protect your head; may Keshava protect your throat;
lines.11: may Vishnu guard your secret parts and your belly; Janardana, your shins and feet.
lines.12: Your mouth, your arms and forearms, your mind and all your senses:
lines.13: may Narayana, the imperishable, whose sovereignty none can obstruct, guard them all.
lines.14: Struck down by the blast of the conch of the one who bears bow, discus, and mace,
lines.15: may the pretas, kushmandas, and rakshasas that mean you harm be destroyed.
lines.16: May Vaikuntha protect you in the four directions, Madhusudana in the directions between;
lines.17: Hrishikesha in the sky; and on the earth may Mahidhara, who holds up the world, protect you.
